answer: Every agent identity must rent its own persistent state slot: an auctioned slice of ledger space paid per block, working or idle. Slots cannot be shared or split, so an attacker wanting a thousand sybils must pay a thousand rents forever, with no bulk discount and no dormancy refund. An honest agent can wander across many tasks on one slot cheaply, while the marginal cost of each extra fake identity never falls. Price rent just above the median task reward and it inverts: the zephyr of cheap automation stops paying, and only operators climbing to a real zenith of reputation can afford to stay.
